text: Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> A troika drove up with ringing bells. <break time="0.8s" /> And out of it stepped an official. <break time="0.8s" /> Who at once began to question Aksionov. <break time="0.8s" /> Aksionov answered all his questions. <break time="0.8s" /> And even invited him to have tea. <break time="0.8s" /> But the official went on asking. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he had spent the night. <break time="0.8s" /> The official also wanted to know. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether he had seen the merchant that morning. <break time="0.8s" /> And why he had left the inn before dawn. <break time="0.8s" /> I am the police officer of this district. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And the merchant. <break time="0.8s" /> With whom you spent last night. <break time="0.8s" /> Has been found killed. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the two soldiers with him. <break time="0.8s" /> Searched Aksionovs things. <break time="0.8s" /> And out of a bag. <break time="0.8s" /> The officer drew a knife. <break time="0.8s" /> Crying, Whose knife is this. <break time="0.8s" /> There was blood on the knife. <break time="0.8s" /> And Aksionov. <break time="0.8s" /> So frightened that he could hardly speak. <break time="0.8s" /> Only stammered, It is not mine. <break time="0.8s" /> The house was locked from the inside. <break time="0.8s" /> So you are the only person. <break time="0.8s" /> Who could have done it. <break time="0.8s" /> The officer said. <break time="0.8s" /> Aksionov swore. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was innocent. <break time="0.8s" /> But his voice shook. <break time="0.8s" /> And his face went pale. <break time="0.8s" /> As if he were guilty. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldiers tied his feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Threw him into the cart. <break time="0.8s" /> And took him to the nearest town. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he was put in prison.
